content:
Apple yesterday released the second developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, and the public beta is now also available. Details below.

The public beta 1 of macOS 27.2 is now available for download.

Apple announced last week that it would skip the macOS 27.1 testing cycle and go straight to releasing the first developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate. The company yesterday rolled out the second developer beta.

This move appears to be related to the iPhone Duo, which goes on sale on October 23 with iOS 27.1 pre-installed. iOS 27.1 focuses mainly on features and changes specific to this new foldable device, so Apple is pushing its other operating systems directly to 27.2 for testing.

The most notable change in the macOS 27.2 beta so far is the expansion of languages supported by Siri AI, a goal Apple has committed to reaching in October. In macOS 27.2 Golden Gate beta 2, Siri AI adds support for French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish on top of the existing English support.

The build number of the macOS 27.2 public beta 1 is 26B5091g, the same as the second developer beta.

To join Apple's free public beta programme, please visit beta.apple.com.
